_comment: Arris STB / Universal Electronics RemoteUnit profile. Values come from a decrypted dump of the real remote (dump_remote.py) — Consumer Page (0x0C) for nav/channel/transport/TV/PROFILE, Keyboard Page (0x07) for the numeric keypad. Loaded at hid_remote.py startup via HID_REMOTE_KEYMAP env var. Schema: { '<KEY_NAME>': '<hex>' }. KEY_* names route through the keyboard HID report; everything else routes through the consumer HID report (see hid_remote.py parse_key/send_key). VOICE and SOURCE are IR-only on this remote and therefore absent here.
